messages:
nina: Noticed p99 tail increase after kernel-selector change. Flamegraph points to tokenizer + http2 frame parsing.

ash: Which selector change?

nina: micro-kernel cutoff moved 32->40; avg batch size dropped 9.0->5.4. p99 up ~14%.

maria: Quick profile: 30% utf8 token scan, 20% http2 parse, 10% memmove, 8% kvcache misses. writev calls up 3x.

ash: Likely we stopped coalescing small header frames in the micro path. Can we coalesce consecutive small frames into one parse?

nina: I prototyped a coalesce hotpatch using a per-thread scratch buffer and a 2ms proximity window. Pseudo: 
```
if (next_frames_small && within_2ms) { coalesce_into_scratch(); parse_headers(scratch); }
else parse_headers(single_frame);
```
Microbench: header parse calls -48%, token cpu -12%, writev -40% for small writes.

maria: KV cache saw more eviction; bumped per-shard capacity + TTL 5s->12s recovered hit rate 0.94->0.91.

perf-bot: Regression alert created: perf-suite/alerts/6100000000.

ash: Rollout plan: coalesce hotpatch -> 20% canary, kvcache config -> canary, revert cutoff in selector. Also add perf replay for small requests and flamegraph snapshot to rollout checklist.

nina: I'll open the PR for coalesce and add the perf-job. tagging @maria @ash.
